environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind ALB. ALB has AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached with three rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet priority 1 in COUNT mode for baseline telemetry, (2) a custom rule group 'internal-query-sanitizer' priority 2 containing a single RegexPatternSet rule matching URI query string parameters against pattern '(?i)(union|select|insert|update|delete|drop|;|--|\/\*|\*\/|sleep|benchmark|extractvalue|updatexml|load_file|into\s+outfile|case\s+when)' with action BLOCK and field-to-match set to 'AllQueryArguments' with text transformation URL_DECODE followed by LOWERCASE, (3) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet priority 3 in COUNT mode only (not blocking, used for detection metrics). CloudWatch alarm on SQLi detection count >0 triggers SNS notification to security team.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALBv2 with WAFv2 WebACL association
config.compute: ECS Fargate 1.4.0, task role with no additional permissions
config.monitoring: CloudWatch alarm on WAF SQLi metric, SNS to security-ops
